headline: Public hearings and reviews on a Charitable Gaming Facility at South Willow and Gold Streets, and a fueling station at 1265 South Willow Street.
summary: The meeting covers site plan and conditional use applications for properties on South Willow Street, Gold Street, and John E. Devine Drive, plus a fueling station at 1265 South Willow Street. It also includes compliance hearings, amendments, extension requests, and new applications for Regional Impact review.
items: Request to amend the continuance date for SP2026-010, CU2026-004, S2026-011, SP2026-011, and CU2026-005, per letter from Brian Pratt, PE, Fuss & O'Neill, received August 10, 2026.

SP2026-010: New site plan to redevelop five lots into one lot for a proposed 73,240 sq. ft. Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces, at 1279 South Willow Street, 55 and 115 John E. Devine Drive, and 970 and 1050 Gold Street, in a BC-2 Zoning District.
CU2026-004: Conditional use permit to reduce required parking during phased construction at the same five properties, in a BC-2 Zoning District.

S2026-011: Subdivision to adjust the lot line between Lots 6 and 7B at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive, adding 11,683 SF to Lot 6 for a new total of 41,659 SF, in a BC-2 Zoning District.

SP2026-011: Site plan to raze a former fueling station at 1265 South Willow Street and build a new fueling station with a convenience store, drive-through restaurant, and fueling canopy with five double-sided fuel pumps and one kerosene pump, in a BC-2 Zoning District.
CU2026-005: Conditional use permit to reduce on-site parking from 19 required spaces to 14 spaces provided at 1265 South Willow Street, in a BC-2 Zoning District.

PDSP2024-002: Compliance hearing, continued from August 5, 2026, on architectural details of a proposed 457-space steel frame parking deck at Orange Street and Pearl Street, associated with the NeighborWorks development, in the CBD Zoning District.
SP2026-014: Site plan to convert an existing two-family building at 434 Hevey Street into four multi-family residential units, in an MX-2 Zoning District. Continued from August 5, 2026.
SP2025-020 & CU2025-022: Three-month extension request for the approved car wash site plan and parking conditional use at 275 Hooksett Road.
PDSP2025-004: Three-month extension request for the conditionally approved planned development and site plan for a 22-unit townhouse development on Wellington Hill Road.
SP2026-010: New site plan application for the Charitable Gaming Facility, as described above.
CU2026-004: Conditional use permit for reduced parking during phased construction, as described above.
S2026-011: Subdivision lot line adjustment between Lots 6 and 7B, as described above.
SP2026-011: Site plan for the new fueling station at 1265 South Willow Street, as described above.
CU2026-005: Conditional use permit to reduce parking at 1265 South Willow Street, as described above.
SP2022-011: Compliance hearing for a five-story, 98-unit apartment building at 351 Chestnut Street, at the former Manchester Police Department site, in the CBD.
PDSP2024-002: Compliance hearing on architectural details of the 457-space parking deck at Orange Street and Pearl Street, as described above.
SP2026-007: Amendment to conditions of approval for conversion of a two-family building at 192 Mammoth Road into four multi-family units, in an MX-2 Zoning District.
S2026-015: Subdivision lot line adjustment at 975 Cedar St, Auburn Street, and 1040 Auburn Street, reducing lots from three to two, in an MX-1 Zoning District.
SP2026-015: Site plan to add four new units to an existing three-unit building at 159 Union Street, in an MX-2 Zoning District.
SP2023-015: Amendment to an approved site plan at 25 Lowell Street to redevelop the parking lot into a new 71-space private parking lot, in the CBD.
SP2026-014: Site plan to convert a two-family building at 434 Hevey Street into four units, as described above.
SP2025-020 & CU2025-022: Three-month extension request for the car wash and parking reduction at 275 Hooksett Road, as described above.
PDSP2025-004: Three-month extension request for the Wellington Hill Road townhouse development, as described above.
Review of new applications for Regional Impact and comment by the Manchester Conservation Commission.
